chapter: Earl Hines, Chicago and later gigs
title: The Los Angeles apartment building and Joe Louis
summary: They work out the address of the building owned by Della Miles, where Willie Best and others lived; Joe Louis lived nearby.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up under segregation: schools, neighborhoods, Jim Crow

blocks.x: Where was this? Where abouts in Los Angeles?

It was -- Della Miles owned the apartment building and it was over on 36 -- 36th place across Jefferson. And Della Miles was her name. She was married to one of the guys from Buffalo, Marshall Miles -- years ago. And Marshall was -- he was one of the guys that had some money up backing Joe Louis and things like that way back in those days. He was from a family that had money around Buffalo.
No, it was -- I can't think of the exact--
Willy Best lived there too -- a comedian. Willy lived there, I lived there, and Art lived upstairs.
It was on the east side?
36th -- what's the name of that little street? It's a little -- small little street across Jefferson on the other side. It's Saint something or something like that.
St. Andrews. Right on the corner of 36th and St. Andrews. It had a high wall right around the front building, you know, and right next to it was a little apartment building.
That's where it was -- St. Andrews, right on the corner.
You know, Joe Louis used to stay on St. Andrews.
Oh, well, later on he had an apartment
Well, he -- that's where he used to live back there then.
